blocks.text: Paudon ke bohat se cells totipotent hote hain, yaani aik akela cell poora naya paudha bana sakta hai. Is liye biologists paude ke aik transgenic cell se poora naya paudha uga lete hain. Transgenic paude banane ke bare maqsad yeh hain:

items: Bacillus thuringiensis (mitti mein rehne wala bacterium) ke genes bohat se paudon (maslan kapas, chawal, makai, aaloo, tamatar, baingan, phool gobhi, band gobhi waghaira) mein dale gaye hain. Yeh genes aise proteins banate hain jo nuqsan dene wale keeron (insect pests) ko maar dete hain lekin doosre mufeed keeron ko nuqsan nahin dete.
Bohat si faslon ko glyphosate (aik herbicide, yaani jaari booti maar dawa) ke khilaf mehfooz (resistant) banaya gaya hai.

Taraqqi pazeer mulkon ke liye biologists ne GMO (transgenic) chawal (golden rice) banaye hain jin mein iron ki miqdar barhane wale genes dale gaye. Yeh genes phaliyon (beans), Aspergillus fungus aur jangli chawal se liye gaye. Isi tarah beta-carotene (vitamin A banne se pehle ka maadda, precursor) banane wale genes daffodil phool se le kar chawal mein dale gaye. Yeh transgenic chawal un ilaqon mein ugaya aur khaya jata hai jahan khurak mein iron aur vitamin A ki kami hai.
GMO paude aur paudon ke cells biopharmaceuticals (jandaron se banne wali dawaen) banane mein kaam aate hain, maslan cytokines, hormones, antibodies, enzymes aur vaccines waghaira.

blocks.alt: Aik chakkar. Bacillus thuringiensis se us ka gene liya jata hai aur makai ke paude mein dala jata hai. Keera patte khata hai; paude ke banaye proteins keere ko maar dete hain (muRa hua murda keera). Nateeja transgenic paudha hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Har saal iron ki kami 1.4 billion (1 arab 40 crore) auraton ko mutasir karti hai, aur vitamin A ki kami 670,000 bachchon ki jaan le leti hai aur bachpan ke na-qabil-e-ilaaj andhepan ke 500,000 cases ka sabab banti hai.

blocks.title: Golden rice ke baare mein
blocks.text: Naam 'golden rice' asal mein beta-carotene (vitamin A) wale chawal ka hai jis ke daane sunehre (peele) hote hain. Phaliyon, Aspergillus aur jangli chawal ke genes se bana zyada iron wala chawal aik mutaliq lekin alag tajurba tha.

blocks.prompt: Aik cell se transgenic paudha banana transgenic janwar banane se aasan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke paudon ke bohat se cells totipotent hain: aik badla hua (transgenic) cell hi poora paudha ban sakta hai.

items: Paudon ke cells totipotent hain, is liye aik transgenic cell se poora paudha ugta hai.
Bt genes wale paude keere maarte hain; glyphosate se mehfooz faslein; iron aur vitamin A wala golden rice; paudon se biopharmaceuticals.
